name: OpenDataBench
description: OpenDataBench is a real-world benchmark built from governmental open data to evaluate large language models on complex table question answering and exploratory insight generation tasks. It challenges models to handle multiple large tables, external knowledge, and generate expert-level findings from data analysis.
reputation: OpenDataBench is a newer benchmark with growing interest for evaluating LLMs on real-world table QA and data insight tasks, but it is not yet as widely established as older QA benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on realistic data analysis challenges including multi-table QA and insight generation; top models struggle on both tasks.
